page.layout: One printed title page, set in large and small capitals and roman type, centred. The scan also shows heavy mirrored show-through from the reverse side, which is not transcribed. No margins or notes.
page.notes: The scan is dominated by show-through from the reverse side: mirrored, faint text runs across the whole page, including a large mirrored title near the top and a mirrored imprint near the bottom. None of it has been transcribed. The legible printed line is only a probable date, "ANNO M DC LXXII", and is doubtful. Most lines could not be read at all, so their letter counts are estimates. A printer's device or ornament appears in the lower centre and is not transcribed. The running head and page number are absent.
